Converts a number or a text to an Int (-2147483648 to 2147483647) and stops at -2147483648 and 2147483647 instead of wrapping around. This is a BlitzLLVM extension: the originals have no integers of other sizes. A whole number outside the range becomes the closest number of the range, and a real is rounded to the nearest whole number (halves go to the even one) first. A real that is not a number becomes 0. `Int` does the same for a real, but wraps whole numbers around.

```blitzbasic
;run
Print SatInt(Long(5000000000))
Print SatInt(Long(-5000000000))
Print SatInt(Long(-7))
```

```text
2147483647
-2147483648
-7
```
@param value  A number or a text with a number in it.
@returns The number, or the closest number of the type if it does not fit.
@gap Not in the originals, which have no integers of other sizes.
